    p = power(x, y // 2)

    if y % 2 == 1:

    dp = [[0] * (k + 1) for _ in range(n + 1)]

    fact = [1] * (n + 1)
    inv_fact = [1] * (n + 1)
    for i in range(2, n + 1):
        fact[i] = fact[i - 1] * i % MOD
        inv_fact[i] = pow(fact[i], MOD - 2, MOD)
    
    # Fill the dp table
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        for j in range(1, min(i, k) + 1):
            dp[i][j] = dp[i - 1][j - 1] + j * dp[i - 1][j]
            dp[i][j] %= MOD
    
    # Calculate the sum of weights of all partitions
    total_weight = 0
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        for j in range(1, k + 1):
            if dp[i][j] == 0:

            # Calculate the weight of the current partition
            weight = dp[i][j] * fact[i] * inv_fact[j] * inv_fact[i - j] % MOD
            for w in weights:
                weight = weight * (w + i) % MOD
            total_weight = (total_weight + weight) % MOD
    
    return total_weight
